messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: P99 latency spike in US-WEST and EU-WEST (streaming path). p95 -> 900ms (baseline 180ms), p99 -> 2.4s (baseline 420ms). Streaming stall rate +8x over last 12m. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Links: https://metrics.redwood/incident/5222223333 :rotating_light:
oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Where's the scope?
emily: I'm pulling top-level graphs now. p95 in us-west jumped at 5222223200 (approx) coinciding w/ a config rollout. p95=0.9s, p99=2.4s. Error rate for streaming chunks up from 0.3% -> 6.8% over the same window.

emily: Quick check of cache metrics shows prefix-cache hit rate collapsed from ~92% to 18% across streaming shard group usw-1. Prefetch queue depth spiked 12x.
```# sample metrics snapshot
time: 2026-03-15T02:46Z
prefix_cache_hit: 0.18
prefetch_queue_depth: 1240
stream_chunk_errors: 6.8%
```
jia: We rolled out prefix-hash-v2 at 5222223185 to 30% traffic for the namespace-salt change. That aligns with the hitrate drop. I saw a couple of 502s in the runtime logs where KV lookups returned misses then upstream fallback timed out.
maria: Confirming. The rollout changed the hashing salt and introduced a new namespace mapping. Some hot prefixes are landing on different shards -> cold reads. That explains prefetch thrash + tail latency.
oncall: Customer impact? which customers see streaming interruptions?
sam: CS report: 3 customers reported degraded streaming sessions (large convo apps). One enterprise (acct: starlark) seeing chunk dropout ~30% during streaming. They're on us-west-primary.
oliver: Notified starlark that we're investigating and will mitigate. They asked for ETA. I'll keep them updated every 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Short-term mitigation options: 1) revert prefix-hash-v2 rollout (flip flag to 0%) 2) force route streaming traffic to legacy hashing path 3) temporarily increase prefetch workers and warm top hot prefixes 4) add a KV warmup task for known hot keys. Recommend 1+3 now.
jia: Agreed. I can flip the rollout flag if we want immediate rollback. Command: ``/infra-flag set prefix_hash_rollout_percent=0 --env production``
emily: Also recommend temporarily lowering batching window for streaming to reduce head-of-line waits until cache warms. That will slightly increase tokens per second cost but reduce p99.

deploy-bot: Runbook check: rollback_toggle (doc: https://runbooks.redwood/prefixhash-rollback). Confirmed flag exists in config-service.

oncall: Jia, please flip the flag. Emily and Maria, can you warm hot prefixes and bump prefetch workers? I will open an incident bridge and notify CS.
jia: Running toggle now. ``/infra-flag set prefix_hash_rollout_percent=0 --env production`` -> started at 5222223338.

jia: Flag update succeeded. rollout_percent=0.0. Traffic should start moving to legacy hashing within 30s of shard updates.
emily: Starting warming job for top-5k prefixes (approx). Command: ``jobs/kv-rewarm --prefix-file s3://ops/hot-prefixes-20260315.csv --parallel 50``. Kickoff at 5222223346.
maria: Increasing prefetch workers on usw-*-streaming pool from 6 -> 18 to absorb cold read churn. Command executed at 5222223352.

emily: Metrics 60s after rollback: prefix_cache_hit back up to 44% (was 18), prefetch queue depth down 65%. p95 dropping to 320ms, p99 to 560ms. Streaming errors decreased to 1.7%.
sam: Notified starlark with the mitigation summary and expected full recovery within 20-30m. They replied :thumbsup: and asked for postmortem.
oncall: Nice. We're seeing recovery but still above SLO. Keep warming for 30m. Maria, leave prefetch worker bump in place for now. Jia, schedule a rollback-to-stable patch for the prefix-hash-v2 change and make a migration plan for salt mapping.
jia: I'll create a revert PR and an engineered rollout plan with canary checks before reintroducing. Assigning to runtime team. PR link: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/7893
maria: I'll run a controlled rehash test in a staging cluster with traffic replay to measure cache impact and hot-key mapping before we try again.
oliver: CS: starlark confirmed sessions improving, will wait for final signoff before closing ticket.
oncall: Handing off to next oncall (tara) at 5222223475. Summary for handoff: p99/p95 spike caused by prefix-hash-v2 partial rollout that changed salt/mapping -> cache miss surge -> prefetch thrash -> streaming stalls for high-volume customers. Mitigations applied: rollout flag set to 0 (jia), prefetch workers scaled (maria), rewarm job started (emily). Current state: p95 ~300-350ms, p99 ~500-700ms, cache hit trending up to baseline. Customer impact: 3 customers, one enterprise (starlark) with streaming chunk drop. Next actions for night oncall: monitor metrics, keep prefetch scaling until hit rate >80% for 15m, finalize revert PR and schedule a safe re-rollout with staged canaries and telemetry gating. Incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/5222223333/postmortem

deploy-bot: Created incident bridge room #incident-5222223333 and linked runbook.
oncall: Thanks team. Switching to watch mode. Tara you're up in 10. :eyes:
